title: psychotria micralabastra

It is native to the tropical regions of South America and has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including the treatment of fever, rheumatism, and gastrointestinal issues. The plant's therapeutic actions include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties, which are attributed to its bioactive constituents such as alkaloids, flavonoids, and phenolic acids.
